t: A palm-sized Intel PC module that plugs into a carrier board.
steps: Buy the LattePanda Mu Evaluation Kit from DigiKey or DFRobot. It includes the Lite carrier and an active cooler.
Get a USB-C PD charger or a 12 to 20 volt power adapter.
Use a 12 volt supply to make the PCIe x4 slot work.
Connect a monitor, a keyboard, and a mouse.
Make a Ubuntu installer on a USB stick, or set up Windows 11.
Boot and install the operating system to the built-in storage.
Try a first project, such as installing Proxmox for a home lab.
meta: Open Board. From $189. A few stores.
